patch.value: Resolve PR #79 review threads: hermetic release-alert evidence and audit timestamp correction

Clears the two unresolved CodeRabbit threads on unbraind/pm-brief PR #79. Thread 1 (3836774695): replace YAML-parse-only evidence for the alert-on-release-failure job with a hermetic test of the actual script, extracted verbatim into scripts/alert-on-release-failure.sh. Thread 2 (3836774697): append-only timestamp correction on pm-brief-v2ts.

value.author: pi-agent
value.text: Findings. Thread 1 (CodeRabbit 3836774695, correct): the alert-on-release-failure job's whole behaviour was an inline bash script whose only recorded evidence was a YAML parse check. A real release run cannot serve as evidence because it merges a release commit into protected main and burns a version before reaching any failing publish step. Resolution: extracted the step's run block verbatim into scripts/alert-on-release-failure.sh; the job now checks out the repository (permissions gained contents: read for that checkout only) and runs 'bash scripts/alert-on-release-failure.sh', so workflow and tests execute identical bytes. test/alert-on-release-failure.test.ts stubs gh on PATH and asserts: (a) no existing issue -> exactly one gh issue create with label release-failure and title 'Daily Release workflow is failing' plus body containing job name, run URL, commit SHA, UTC date; (b) existing open issue #77 -> one gh issue comment on 77, zero creates (cross-run dedup); (c) every gh call fails -> exit 0 with ::warning:: line (non-blocking). Mutation proof: breaking the dedup lookup (existing_number emptied) makes 3/4 tests fail; restored, 4/4 pass - the suite is not vacuous. shellcheck v0.10.0 clean. Gates after change: npm test 274 pass, npm run coverage thresholds met (100/92.15/100), pm health --strict-exit ok, changelog:full + changelog:check green. Thread 2 (CodeRabbit 3836774697, correct): pm-brief-v2ts note dated 2026-08-22T18:49:40.600Z claimed 'as of 2026-08-22T19:00Z'. Fixed append-only via pm comments on pm-brief-v2ts stating the misstatement, the actual observation time, and reaffirming that pm-brief-gtiy was in_progress when PR #76 merged; history entry untouched so the hash chain stays intact; pm health --strict-exit re-verified green.

patch.value: Both threads addressed: hermetic same-bytes alert-script evidence added and mutation-proven (3/4 fail broken, 4/4 pass fixed), append-only timestamp correction appended to pm-brief-v2ts; all gates green (npm test 274, coverage thresholds met, pm health --strict-exit ok, changelog full+check green, shellcheck clean)
